mapper.select: select a.*, p.name lci_product_name, p.code lci_product_code, ma.name lci_linked_name, d.name lci_device_name, lci.id lci_id, lci.logical lci_logical, p.protocol_code lci_protocol_code , ma.direct lci_direct, lci.value lci_value, lci.operator lci_operator, lci.linked_id lci_linked_id, lci.type_name lci_type_name, lci.linkage_condition_id lci_linkage_condition_id , lci.event_source_detail_id lci_event_source_detail_id, lci.product_id lci_product_id, lci.uid lci_uid, lci.type lci_type, lci.type_value lci_type_value from iot_linkage_condition a left join iot_linkage_condition_item lci on a.id=lci.linkage_condition_id left join iot_product p on lci.product_id = p.id left join iot_device d on d.uid = lci.uid left join iot_model_api ma on ma.id = lci.linked_id where a.linkage_item_id=#{linkageItemId} and a.linkage_action_id is null order by a.sort, lci.sort
